title: Draconic Ancestry

Draconic Ancestries are a set of related passive features available to Dragonborn and Draconic Bloodline sorcerers. The subclass versions of these ancestries are similar to, but distinct from, the racial versions.

Dragonborn race

Each subrace of dragonborn has a Draconic Ancestry which grants resistance to the associated elemental damage type.

Draconic Bloodline sorcerer

At level 1, Draconic Bloodline sorcerers select a Draconic Ancestry which grants a spell associated with the bloodline and later, damage resistance and damage bonus with the associated elemental damage type. If the sorcerer is also a dragonborn, this ancestry does not need to match the dragonborn's racial ancestry.

Draconic Ancestry Damage Type Description Grants
Red ⁠Fire Fire is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Burning Hands
Black ⁠Acid Acid is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Grease*
Blue ⁠Lightning Lightning is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Witch Bolt
White ⁠Cold Cold is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Armour of Agathys*
Green ⁠Poison Poison is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Ray of Sickness
Gold ⁠Fire Fire is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Disguise Self
Silver ⁠Cold Cold is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Feather Fall
Bronze ⁠Lightning Lightning is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Fog Cloud
Copper ⁠Acid Acid is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Tasha's Hideous Laughter*
Brass ⁠Fire Fire is the damage type associated with your dragon ancestor. Sleep

*Denotes a spell not otherwise part of the Sorcerer spell list.
